sources.label: Custom Morphe patches (Weather&Radar, Skat). Built from the official Morphe patc
sources.author: TorbenStriegel
patch_list: Removes banner and fullscreen (interstitial) ads from the game. Interstitials are reported as shown and closed immediately so the Qt game flow is unaffected. Works without an account.
Removes the PairIP license check that redirects to the Play Store and exits on sideloaded installs.
